Empowering Rifts you create grant Overload Shot to you and allies inside it, granting weapons disruption on hit.

Weapons that have a Breaker Type, either by mods or intrinsically will not be overwritten.

Does not work with Well of Radiance.

If on Void Subclass:
Casting Empowering Rift grants Devour for 11 seconds.

Empowering Rifts you cast grant <overload/>Overload Shot to you and allies inside it, allowing all weapons to cause disruption on hit.

Weapons that have a Breaker Type, either by mods or intrinsically will not be overwritten. Does not work with Well of Radiance.

If on Void Subclass:
Casting Empowering Rift grants Devour for 11 seconds.

Empowering Rifts you cast grant <overload/>Overload Shot to you and allies inside it, allowing weapons to cause disruption on hit. Does not work with Well of Radiance.

Weapons with a Breaker Type (either intrinsic or from Artifact Perks) will not be overwritten. 

Casting an Empowering Rift with a <void/>Void Subclass equipped grants Devour for 11 seconds.

Empowering Rifts you cast grant <overload/>Overload Shot to you and allies inside it, allowing weapons to cause Disruption on hit. (Does not work with Well of Radiance)

Weapons with a Breaker Type (either intrinsic or from Artifact Perks) will not be overwritten. 

Casting an Empowering Rift with a <void/>Void Subclass equipped grants Devour for 11 seconds.

import overload from global

Stepping into an Empowering Rift cast by you with a <void/>⁠Void Subclass equipped grants <void/>⁠Devour for 11 seconds (17 with <void/>⁠Echo of Persistence).

Kills can refresh <void/>⁠Devour's duration up to 11 seconds (22 with <void/>⁠Echo of Persistence).

Empowering Rifts you cast grant <overload/>⁠Overload Shot to you and allies inside it, allowing weapons to cause <overload/>⁠Disruption on hit.

Weapons with a Breaker Type (either intrinsic or from Artifact Perks) will not benefit from this.

import overload from global

Empowering Rifts cast by you with a <void/>Void Super equipped grant you <void/>Devour for 11 seconds (17 with <void/>Echo of Persistence). Standing in the Rift continuously refreshes <void/>Devour's duration (needs verification).

Kills can refresh <void/>Devour's duration up to 11 seconds (22 with <void/>Echo of Persistence).

Empowering Rifts you cast grant <overload/>Overload Shot to you and allies inside it, allowing weapons to cause <overload/>Disruption on hit.

Weapons with a Breaker Type (either intrinsic or from Artifact Perks) will not benefit from this.

import overload from global

Empowering Rifts you cast grant <overload/>Overload Shot to you and allies inside it, allowing weapons to cause <overload/>Disruption on hit.

Weapons with a Breaker Type (either intrinsic or from Artifact Perks) will not benefit from this.

Empowering Rifts cast by you with a <void/>Void Super equipped have additional behaviors:
• Standing in the Rift grants you <void/>Devour for 11 seconds (unaffected by <void/>Echo of Persistence)
• Exiting and re-entering the Rift sets the duration of <void/>Devour to 11 seconds (even if you had a longer duration)

Kills can refresh the duration of <void/>Devour granted by <yellow Secant Filaments /> up to 11 seconds (22 with <void/>Echo of Persistence).

Empowering Rifts you cast grant <overload/>Overload Shot to you and allies inside it. Formerly, this allowed non-intrinsic weapons to gain <overload/>Disruption, with the exception that it could not overwrite pre-existing intrinsics.

However, now that <bold all /> weapons have an intrinsic Breaker-type, Secants can no longer overwrite any of them. This breaks the UI in your weapons tray and leaves this portion of the exotic non-functional.
